answer: A proposed proof-of-retention seals oasis imagery, ripple telemetry and yarrow assays into a different 384-GiB sequentially encoded replica per key. Independent auditors probe 48 random chunks per key at the same surprise instant across 20 epochs; validators check signed timings and roots, withholding pending pay on a late, missing or reused proof. A farm can share its model or rent disks, but each extra key needs another live replica and simultaneous read capacity: recomputing a chained replica on demand misses the deadline. MinePoA does not enforce this.
